about_the_game:
It watches you through your webcam

This is a horror game where the monster can see you through your webcam—physically duck beneath your real-life desk to hide during intense stealth and chase sequences. Don't let it catch even a glimpse of your face.

Blurring the line between game and reality

This game uses various webcam and fourth-wall-breaking interactions to create a deeply immersive horror experience where your real-world actions matter.

Hunted by something strange

Listening to your microphone and your every move, this AI-driven entity will do anything in its power to see your face. Every corner you turn is a chance for it to catch you. Listen closely, stay quiet, and be ready to hide your face at all costs.

You are not supposed to play this game

Clip out into a mysterious out-of-bounds area and carefully explore. Uncover the truth behind this abandoned game and why “heaven” is so deeply hidden.

Features

  • Webcam based interactions – Hide from the monster by physically moving in real life.

  • Microphone interaction – Stay quiet, or it will hear you.

  • Fourth-wall breaking horror – Expect the unexpected.

  • Intense stealth and chase sequences – Survive against the AI-driven entity hunting you.

  • Exploration and discovery - Carefully explore this strange game and uncover its mystery.

Additional notes:

  • This game uses your webcam only for gameplay purposes—all processing happens locally on your computer. No images, videos, or data are collected or sent anywhere.

  • You can turn off the webcam mechanic in settings at any time.

  • The game is a work in progress—features and visuals may change before release.

content_descriptors.notes: This is a horror game with dark themes that heavily breaks the fourth wall, which some players may find disturbing.
